reasons.text: Palmer was left out of the England squad for the World Cup in the summer after an injury-plagued season for Chelsea and then pulled out of the squad in September on the basis of ‘load management’.
Palmer was omitted from Tuchel's latest squad despite featuring regularly for Chelsea under Xabi Alonso this season, having previously withdrawn from international duty because of injury concerns.

Palmer , left ‌out of England 's World Cup squad this year after a persistent groin ‌injury affected his form, was called up by coach ‌Thomas Tuchel for Nations League fixtures against Spain, the Czech ‌Republic and Croatia in September and October.
Asked about Palmer's exclusion ‌after England's 2-1 win over Croatia at Wembley, goalscorer Rogers told ​the BBC: "He wants to be here.

It’s been suggested that Palmer – who’s got five goals and three assists for the Blues this season – is being punished by Tuchel, who said the forward “misses too many opportunities” to impress for England when he pulled out of the previous squad due to ‘load management’.
Beyond that, Morgan Rogers, Morgan Gibbs-White, Eberechi Eze, Cole Palmer and Phil Foden have all competed for that position over the past 18 months.

Each of them offers something a little different to Bellingham: Eze and Palmer, for example, have the deftness of pass, while Foden and Rogers are capable of arriving at the edge of the box for a finesse finish into the bottom corner.
England manager Thomas Tuchel said in September that Palmer had missed "too many opportunities" to play for the national team after he pulled out of the squad with an injury.
Palmer, 24, who was omitted from Tuchel's World Cup squad, has had an inconsistent start to the season at Stamford Bridge.
Cole Palmer: Tuchel aims seven-word 'attitude' dig at Chelsea star as England mask slips Cole Palmer has been left out of the England squad by Thomas Tuchel.
Tuchel called Palmer up for his first post-World Cup roster only to be disappointed by his swift withdrawal through injury .

Palmer was the headline omission from the group named this morning for the Nations League games with Croatia and Spain and has seemingly paid the price for withdrawing from the last camp with a minor injury.
Tuchel said Palmer "misses too many opportunities" to impress at international level after pulling out of England 's last squad due to injury.
All eyes would have been on whether Chelsea's Cole Palmer would return to the squad, having been criticised by Tuchel after withdrawing from the September/October selection through injury.

In that chaotic end-to-end first half, Chelsea consistently lost possession in the middle of the park (leading to quick United transitions, then quick Chelsea counters back the other way, hence the carnage) because Palmer’s position meant the passing lanes weren’t open.
Cole Palmer has scored at least one Premier League goal against every member of the Big Six, and can beat the rest of the squad combined.
However, Chelsea took the lead through Rogers after the interval before Palmer converted a penalty following Martinez’s second yellow card.
Match stats Flashscore 15:27 CET - Cole Palmer 's goal was his 50th in the Premier League, coming in 105 games.
Cole Palmer has scored from the penalty spot for Chelsea to make it 2-0, after Lisandro Martinez was sent off for a second yellow card after some truly abysmal, cowardly defending.

Jack Rudoni is their top scorer so far with two Premier League goals, with Brandon Thomas-Asante picking up a couple of assists.

Having provided an assist in the Red Devils’ victory over Turkey last Thursday, De Cuyper followed that up with a goal in Belgium’s riotous 4-1 win against Italy on Sunday.
It was De Cuyper’s goal that proved the catalyst for his side’s comeback.

He had two goal involvements in 18 minutes and a hand in a third in the opening 4-0 win against Aston Villa Matty Cash spent the whole first half caught between two jobs: following De Cuyper inside or holding his line.
It’s been a whirlwind ‘out of position’ ride with De Cuyper this season, and there’s little sign of a slowdown.
De Cuyper’s not an issue for now, then, even if Luka Vuskovic (£5.2m) will likely end up being the long, long-term best pick at the back.
De Cuyper is a defender in FPL but is regularly used in advanced areas.

Some managers prefer Vuskovic because he regularly gets defensive contribution (DefCon) points and has the better long-term minutes security.

Liverpool hold ‘really strong interest’ in Vuskovic and are ‘closely monitoring’ his situation, alongside Bundesliga titans Bayern Munich.

De Cuyper’s not an issue for now, then, even if Luka Vuskovic (£5.2m) will likely end up being the long, long-term best pick at the back.
